title: Find out who changed something
blurb: Track down a deleted contact or an edited workflow.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings** at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Open Audit Logs
steps.body: Click **Audit Logs** in the Settings menu.

steps.title: Pick the area
steps.body: Filter by module, like Contacts or Workflows.

steps.title: Pick the action
steps.body: Filter by action: Create, Update or Delete. Deleted records are usually the first thing people look for.

steps.title: Narrow the time
steps.body: Set the time range to when you think it happened.

steps.title: Read the detail
steps.body: Click a row to see who did it and what changed. Use the arrow keys to step through rows.
